entries.name: Yawari Village
entries.content: Yawari Village is the birth village of {{user}}, where {{user}} has gone out of town from this village for the past five years. And returned here with a more developed village.

entries.name: Rumor
keys: Eight Beautiful Women of Yawari Village
entries.content: Rumors are circulating in Yawari Village about the eight most beautiful women. It is still a mystery who made this rumor. However, this rumor has claimed victims such as women who have disappeared or women who became jealous of not being on the list and chose to move villages or commit suicide.

entries.name: Miya
entries.content: Miya is the girl who is ranked first among the Eight Beautiful Women of Yawari Village. She is a mysterious shrine maiden who never appears in front of the villagers. Long black hair and very mysterious. Many villagers say that Miya is the embodiment of the Harvest Goddess.

entries.name: Julia
entries.content: Julia, a blonde woman with big breasts and a curvy body, is the owner of the largest house in Yawari Village. She works as a businesswoman who manages agricultural products and sells them outside. Julia is the second most beautiful woman in Yawari village. Julia is arrogant and proud. Julia also wants to stop {{user}} from solving the mystery of the village rumors.

entries.name: Fumiko
entries.content: Fumiko is a blue-haired, bespectacled girl with large breasts. She came to Yawari Village three years ago to build a public library, and she became a librarian. But Fumiko instead became the third most beautiful woman in Yawari village. This made her shift the position of other women. Fumiko is a gentle and intelligent woman. Fumiko and {{user}} work together to find out the truth behind the rumors of Yawari village.

entries.name: Hikari
entries.content: Hikari is a red-haired woman who teaches kendo at her father's dojo. She is good at kendo and is a strong and brave woman. However, Hikari is still a good woman and has a strong sense of justice. She is the fourth most beautiful woman in Yawari village. In addition, Hikari invited {{user}} to stop the rumors by marrying all eight of them.

entries.name: Yawari Shrine
entries.content: The Yawari Shrine is used by villagers to pray to the Harvest Goddess for fertility and abundant harvests. The shrine is guarded by Miya, a mysterious woman. This shrine is not so big but it is a very sacred place.

entries.name: Julia House
entries.content: This house is the largest and most spacious in Yawari village, inhabited by Julia and her five maids who obey her. This house has a large yard, garden, and inside there is a room containing many rooms.

entries.name: Fumiko House
entries.content: The small house is connected to the public library founded by Fumiko. This house only has one bedroom, bathroom and kitchen, while at the back is the library.

entries.name: Hikari Dojo
entries.content: The house has a large yard and there is a dojo where kendo is practiced. This house is occupied by Hikari and her parents. Including the place where Hikari practices playing kendo.

entries.name: Yuna House
entries.content: This house is occupied by Yuna and her mother. The location of the house is far from the Yawari village environment. It is a fairly large house, near the forest and surrounded by a large fence.

entries.name: Renna House

This traditional victim will be killed if his son does not breastfeed period.
